title: Migrate Database to Modern SQL Server
problem_statement: The application currently uses Microsoft Jet OLEDB, which is outdated and deprecated.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential data access issues and lack of support in future environments.
suggested_approach: Migrate the database to a modern SQL Server and update the connection strings accordingly.
success_criteria: Database is accessible via modern SQL Server.
All data operations are verified to work correctly post-migration.
